A confirmed order can no longer be cancelled.

**Change:** In `OrderService.cancel` (`src/main/java/com/wolinski/shop/orders/internal/OrderService.java`), the order is loaded first. If its status is `CONFIRMED`, the method throws `IllegalStateException("A confirmed order cannot be cancelled")` before anything changes, so the status stays `CONFIRMED`. Other statuses cancel as before.

**Test:** I added `ConfirmedOrderCancellationTest`, which places and confirms an order, asserts that `cancel` throws, and checks that the status is still `CONFIRMED`.

The full test suite passes.
